name: Metaphor Density
description: Examines the frequency and systemic coherence of figurative language, specifically metaphors and similes. AI text generation models often struggle with generating sustained, novel metaphorical imagery, instead falling back on cliches, mixed metaphors, or maintaining a purely literal, hyper-expository tone.
algorithm: Conceptual Metaphor and Figurative Mapping Analysis
mechanism: This system utilizes semantic role labeling and word-sense disambiguation to detect instances where words are used outside their core, literal definitions (e.g., 'the economy *bled* jobs'). It calculates a 'Metaphor Density' score representing the ratio of figurative expressions to literal text. More importantly, it maps the conceptual coherence of these metaphors. LLMs, operating on statistical token prediction rather than embodied human experience, tend to either severely under-utilize metaphors (resulting in a sterile, academic tone even in creative writing) or overuse highly standardized, clichéd metaphors (e.g., 'in today's fast-paced world', 'a double-edged sword'). Furthermore, when forced to be creative, AI frequently generates 'mixed metaphors'—combining incompatible semantic fields because the tokens are statistically adjacent in the training data, not because the underlying visual imagery makes sense. By benchmarking the frequency of novel figurative language against human baseline corpora for the specific writing genre, this algorithm highlights the semantic 'flatness' or hallucinatory conceptual mismatch typical of generative models.
useCase: Crucial for analyzing creative writing, marketing copy, journalism, and personal essays, where human authors naturally weave vivid, culturally grounded, and consistent metaphorical imagery.
strengths:
• Penetrates deep semantic layers; an AI cannot easily fake novel, coherent metaphors simply by changing system prompts.
• Highly effective at detecting AI attempts at 'creative' or 'emotive' writing, which usually collapse into a dense cluster of exhausting clichés.
• Identifies the semantic disconnects (mixed metaphors) that are classic hallmarks of statistical text generation lacking true world comprehension.
limitations:
• Metaphor detection is an open problem in NLP; recognizing highly novel or culturally specific poetic metaphors can trigger false positives or negatives.
• Highly technical, legal, or scientific human writing naturally possesses an extremely low metaphor density, neutralizing this metric's effectiveness in those domains.
• Cannot easily distinguish between an AI and a human writer who relies heavily on unoriginal idioms.
parameters:
Analysis: Word-Sense Disambiguation & Semantic Mapping
Metric: Ratio of Literal vs. Figurative Expressions, Conceptual Coherence
Output: 0-100 Semantic Flatness vs. Figurative Richness Score
accuracy: Moderate to High — 72-84% accuracy in creative/expressive text genres. It acts as a powerful qualitative screener for texts that claim to be deeply personal or artistic.

references.title: Jurafsky, D. & Martin, J.H. (2024). Speech and Language Processing. 3rd Edition.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
